hero.title: With Froshiar, Make Selling Easier
hero.subtitle: The modern, all-in-one ecosystem engineered to elevate your business — seamlessly unifying rapid POS, multi-location inventory, customer debt ledgers, financial reports, and branded online storefronts. Operates 100% offline with zero latency, backed by seamless cloud sync.

features.heading: Everything your business needs
features.subheading: An advanced management system, from local warehouse to branded webstore — built to feel effortless and modern.

onlineStore.title: Online Store with Custom Domain
onlineStore.description: Turn your entire inventory into a fast, branded online storefront in seconds with your own subdomains and direct WhatsApp ordering.

inventory.title: Warehouse & Multi-Stock Control
inventory.description: Real-time stock monitoring, multi-location warehouse tracking, total capital asset evaluation, and smart catalog categorization.

bulkSync.title: One-Tap Instant Bulk Sync
bulkSync.description: Dedicated bulk synchronization that pushes your entire catalog and product media to your online store with maximum throughput.

salesPos.title: Fast POS & Counter Checkout
salesPos.description: Seconds-fast counter checkout, barcode scanner support, flexible invoice discounts, optimized for every mobile and tablet.

receipts.title: Thermal Printing & PDF Invoices
receipts.description: Native Bluetooth and WiFi thermal receipt printing (80mm & 58mm), along with standard PDF invoice export and direct WhatsApp sharing.

debts.title: Customer Debt & Installments
debts.description: Complete customer receivables ledger, partial installment payments, due date reminders, and professional account statement export.

suppliers.title: Supplier Invoices & Payables
suppliers.description: Manage vendor bills, wholesale purchase invoices, outstanding supplier debts, and streamline account reconciliations effortlessly.

staff.title: Staff Accounts & Permission Roles
staff.description: Onboard staff and cashiers with tailored permission levels, activity audit logs, and complete management from the super admin dashboard.

reports.title: Financial Analytics & Net Profit
reports.description: Automated net profit calculations based on cost and retail margins, daily and monthly revenue charts, and top-selling product insights.

expenses.title: Comprehensive Expense Tracking
expenses.description: Record and categorize operating outgoings (shop rent, employee payroll, electricity, utilities) to maintain true register balances.

offlineMode.title: 100% Offline-First Architecture
offlineMode.description: The system keeps operating smoothly even with zero internet connectivity. Sales and database changes persist safely on your device.

cloudSync.title: Cloud Backup & Multi-Device Sync
cloudSync.description: Keep data resilient against hardware loss with automated cloud synchronization, backup export, and instant one-click data restoration.

currency.title: Multi-Currency IQD & USD
currency.description: Native support for Iraqi Dinar (IQD) and US Dollar (USD) with live exchange rate conversion based on current market rates.

stockAlerts.title: Low Stock & Expiry Tracking
stockAlerts.description: Proactive inventory notifications whenever items cross minimum threshold levels or approach product expiration dates.

multiLang.title: Native Kurdish & Bahij Typography
multiLang.description: Purpose-built for Kurdish and English with Bahij Janna typography, right-to-left (RTL) layout, and direct technical pairing.

about.heading: About Froshiar — One Year of Relentless, High-Quality Engineering
about.lead: Froshiar is far more than a standard POS app; it is the culmination of over a year of intensive, non-stop engineering built to the highest architectural standards — empowering business owners to run their entire inventory, sales, and debts straight from their pocket with zero lag and absolute peace of mind.

journey.title: A Year of Tireless Craftsmanship
journey.desc: For over a full year, the Froshiar team has poured intensive engineering and meticulous care into every detail. Thousands of real-world test cases ensure that transactions never stutter, operations never halt, and financial data is perpetually secure.

mission.title: What Is Our Core Mission?
mission.desc: To eradicate chaotic paper ledgers, fragmented calculations, and clunky software. We built Froshiar to be so intuitive that any shop owner can master their complete inventory and revenue workflow from day one without training.

vision.title: What Does the Future Hold?
vision.desc: We are actively engineering the next frontier of smart commerce: automated cloud synchronization, AI-powered stock forecasts, standalone branded online stores, and intelligent tools tailored specifically for local businesses.

advanced.title: How Advanced Is Froshiar?
advanced.desc: Engineered on an ultra-resilient local SQLite architecture that operates 100% offline without dropping a beat. The moment internet is available, your sales and catalogs quietly synchronize with cloud backup and your online storefront.

businessTypes.heading: Engineered for Every Kind of Business
businessTypes.subtitle: From independent retail shops to mega warehouses and distribution networks
